scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @plotted/engine && npx -w web tsc --noEmit
scripts.test:rls: export PATH=/Applications/Docker.app/Contents/Resources/bin:$PATH; eval "$(npx supabase status -o env 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^(API_URL|PUBLISHABLE_KEY|SECRET_KEY)=')" && SUPABASE_URL=$API_URL SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=$PUBLISHABLE_KEY SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY=$SECRET_KEY npm run test:rls -w web
